help.title: TuiEdit — a simple TUI text editor (MS Edit / nano style).
help.k1: ^S save (asks for name if new)   Ctrl+Shift+S save as   ^Q quit
help.k2: ^F find       F3 next / Shift+F3 prev   ^H replace   ^G go to line   Alt+C/W/R — find options
help.k3: ^K cut line  ^U/^V paste  ^C copy line  ^D duplicate  Ctrl+/ comment
help.k4: ^C also puts the copy into the system clipboard (Windows Terminal) — paste with Ctrl+V
help.k5: ^Z undo  ^Y redo  ^A select all   Shift+arrows — selection
help.k6: arrows/Home/End/PgUp/PgDn, Ctrl+arrows — by word, Alt+up/down — move line, Alt+] — matching bracket
help.k7: Enter — new line, Tab — indent, Shift+Tab — unindent
help.k8: Terminal clipboard paste — as full text in a single undo step
help.k9: F10 or Alt+F/E/H — menu (arrows/Enter/Esc, letter hotkey)
help.k10: Open/Save as — manager (arrows • Enter • Alt+←/→ — folders • Esc)
help.k11: F1 — this help (arrows — scroll)   Alt+N — line numbers   Alt+Z — word wrap   F9 — file format
help.k12: In manager name field: Shift+arrows — selection • Ctrl+arrows — by word
help.k13: Ctrl+B — file panel (arrows — select • Enter — open • Esc — back to text)
help.k14: Tabs: Ctrl+PgDn/PgUp — next/prev • Ctrl+T — new • Ctrl+W — close
help.k16: Split: Alt+S — split • F6 — neighbour pane • Ctrl+1..9 — pane N
